instruction.name: xvpickve2gr.du
instruction.description: Pick the 64-bit element at lane `idx` from `a`, zero-extend it to the GPR width, and store it in `dst`.

experiments.name: round trip through the reverse move
experiments.notes: Re-measured on 2026-11-17 with the slope method at --unroll 1000 --unroll2 4000: the round trip reads 7.03 cycles, and xvreplgr2vr.d is 1 cycle, so xvpickve2gr.du is 6 cycles.

latencies.notes: xvpickve2gr.du latency is 6 cycles, the same as the signed variants. It is measured as a round trip through xvreplgr2vr.d (7.03 cycles) minus that move's 1-cycle latency.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvpickve2gr.du $r12, $xr8, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r13, $xr9, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r14, $xr10, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r15, $xr11, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r16, $xr12, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r17, $xr13, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r18, $xr14, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r19, $xr15, 0
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvpickve2gr.du $r12, $xr8, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r13, $xr9, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r14, $xr10, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r15, $xr11, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r16, $xr12, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r17, $xr13, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r18, $xr14, 0; xvpickve2gr.du $r19, $xr15, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 7.99 cycles. Counter 0xfa normalised per instruction. The measured CPI 0.9988 is the nominal 1 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: Vector insert/extract/replication instruction. Throughput uses 8 independent lanes. Latency 6 cycles from a xvreplgr2vr.d round trip of 7.03 cycles.
